queries: WITH country_averages AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings AS cs JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.country) SELECT country, avg_points, avg_wins, avg_wins - (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) FROM country_averages) AS wins_vs_country_average FROM country_averages ORDER BY country

assumptions.assumption: Each constructor standing at each race has equal weight in its country's averages.

alternatives.interpretation: Give each race equal weight by averaging its constructor standings first.

assumptions.assumption: Each constructor standing at a race counts equally. The comparison uses the unweighted mean of the country-level average wins.

alternatives.interpretation: Give each race equal weight within its country, regardless of how many constructor standings it has.
